structured_output.summary: The diff implements RegExp.prototype.compile in the assigned file, following the four spec steps. Step 2 uses require_regexp (RequireInternalSlot) with `?`. Step 3 checks that pattern is an Object with a RegExpMatcher slot. Its 3a throws a TypeError when flags is not undefined. Its 3b/3c copy OriginalFlags and OriginalSource. Step 4 returns `?` regexp_initialize(...) as the object. No Get/Set calls are added where the spec has none. The only extra branch is a defensive TypeError when agent.native::<RegExpData> fails after has_regexp_matcher returned true. That path is unreachable and not observable. The remaining test262 failures come from unimplemented RegExp.prototype.toString and the global getter, which the gate reports as honest not-implemented errors. The renamed `_new_target` parameter is a trivial, related change. I could not verify the support::regexp helpers, but the build passes.
